title: Hebrews Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on Hebrews 6: pressing on to perfection, the land that drinks the rain, God's oath to Abraham, and hope as an anchor of the soul.

questions.text: What does the writer call the readers to press on to?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says: leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let us press on to perfection.

answers.text: A new foundation of dead works

questions.text: Which of these is named in verse 2 among the teachings of the first principles?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 lists the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

questions.text: What does the text say about those who were once enlightened and then fell away?
questions.explanation: Verses 4 to 6 say that it is impossible to renew them again to repentance, seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again and put him to open shame.

answers.text: They must be baptized a second time
It is impossible to renew them again to repentance
They will be restored after seven years
They may return at any time without cost

questions.text: What does the land that drinks the rain and produces a crop receive?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it and produces a crop receives blessing from God.

answers.text: Praise from the one who tilled it

questions.text: What is said to be the end of the land that bears thorns and thistles?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says that if it bears thorns and thistles it is rejected and near being cursed, and its end is to be burned.

questions.text: What does verse 10 say God will not forget?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says God is not unrighteous, so as to forget their work and the labor of love which they showed toward his name, in that they served the saints.

answers.text: The offerings brought to the temple
Your work and the labor of love toward his name
The names written in the book of the law
The years spent in the wilderness

questions.text: When God made a promise to Abraham, by whom did he swear?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says that since he could swear by no one greater, he swore by himself.

questions.text: What two things does the promise quoted in verse 14 say God will do?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 quotes the promise: "Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you."

questions.text: What image does verse 19 use for the hope we have?
questions.explanation: Verse 19 says this hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast.

questions.text: Who is said to have entered as a forerunner for us?
questions.explanation: Verse 20 says Jesus entered there for us as a forerunner, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.
